base: origin/main (impact-geometry commits a873466/09d53d3 are NOT required; no file here comes from that branch)
notes: handedness = effective handedness after any load-time mirroring (all left for the left humanoid)
quality for multisense/cmu is a proxy (1-0.15*n_qc_flags); Mason uses video quality_score
CMU and MultiSense carry attribution requirements: see 'ack'
MultiSense entries are tagged needs_counsel / commercial_ok=false (published as CC0 but participants are identifiable); see license_note
licence facts: see data/provenance.py LICENSE_FACTS; commercial_cleared(entry) = commercial_ok and not counsel_required (MultiSense is counsel_required)
weight_train = default weight from unified_v2_sampling.json (train split only; val weight 0)
unified_v2 honors handedness_unverified/exclude_pending_verification: flagged entries have split='excluded' (split_v1 holds the v1 split) and weight 0; weights renormalised

entries.flag_note: handedness detected RIGHT (confidence 0.12), stated left, cues disagree; may not be Mason. Val split. Unverified.
handedness unverified (detected left, lead-arm cue says right). Train split. Unverified.

entries.note: caption-flagged flipped edit of a left-handed swing, un-mirrored back to left
slow-mo: video-time axis stretched; excluded from default sampling
